This '''silk''', produced by [[Kashyyyk treeworm]]s, was valued for its significant tensile strength. The material was available in the area around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], and its durability was unmatched in that region as of<ref name="Card" /> [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref>''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of {{Film|V}}, which this ''Customizable Card Game'' expansion set parallels, in this [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Silk/Legends|silk]] of the Kashyyyk treeworm was mentioned in the flavor text of a card from the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'s ''[[Cloud City Limited]]'' expansion set, released in [[1997]].<ref name="Card" />
